_meta.description: Tier 2 — Administration Import & Migration navigation per REQ-AIM-010. Adds the 'Import & migration' menu with the import wizard, batch list, batch detail (reports + reversal action via lifecycleActions), and the mapping review grid, bound to the canonical ImportBatch / ImportMapping schemas. The multi-step wizard (upload via NC Files picker → profile selection → mapping review → validation findings → dry-run report → post) is described as a sequence over the batch detail + mapping grid; the single-screen wizard host references a custom component noted as deferred until the wizard component lands.

pages.title: Import wizard
pages._note: A single-screen host for a six-stage migration run (upload via the Nextcloud Files picker, source-profile selection, mapping review, validation findings, dry-run report, post) whose stages each drive a different backend lifecycle call on one ImportBatch. `type: form` submits one object once and its config.steps only partition that object's own fields into pages — it cannot run validate, dry-run and post between stages, nor block progress on validation findings. The wizard component itself is DEFERRED (see config['x-deferred']): until it lands the page renders the empty state and the same flow is operable through ImportBatches / ImportMappings / ImportBatchDetail.

config.x-deferred: The wizard host references an ImportWizard.vue component that does not exist yet — and `config.component` is read by nothing (CnPageRenderer resolves a custom page as `page.component || page.slots.main`), so the key has been removed rather than left looking wired. Until the component lands the flow is fully operable as a sequence: create an ImportBatch (ImportBatches → new), review accounts in the Mapping grid (ImportMappings), then drive the lifecycle (validate → dry-run → post) from the batch detail's lifecycleActions and read the validation/dry-run reports in its tabs.

x-deferred-steps.description: Select the XAF auditfile and any companion CSVs from Nextcloud Files (link, not copied).

x-deferred-steps.label: Source system
x-deferred-steps.description: Choose the source package profile (xaf-generic / e-boekhouden / exact-online / moneybird / snelstart).

x-deferred-steps.description: Review RGS-auto and profile-default rows, confirm suggestions, resolve unmapped accounts.

x-deferred-steps.description: Run validation; error findings block posting.

x-deferred-steps.label: Dry-run
x-deferred-steps.description: Generate the would-be result report; mandatory before posting.

x-deferred-steps.label: Post
x-deferred-steps.description: Post the opening journal, open items, and relations.

config._note: MASTER archetype (native CnDetailPage). An import batch is a staged administration migration (XAF + companion CSVs → opening journal, open items, relations) that owns its ImportMapping review rows (FK batchReference) as the actual mapping-review surface, so it renders via relatedCollections rather than a bespoke object-list widget. KEY: the prop is `relatedCollections` — a `relatedLists` block is not a prop on any Cn page component, lands in $attrs and renders nothing. TOKEN: `@objectId` — ImportMapping.batchReference is documented as "UUID or slug" and ImportBatch exposes no flat batch-reference field, so the UUID is the only value reachable from a filter token. The source XAF/CSV files are metadata on sourceFiles (Nextcloud Files references, linked not stored) so the Documents sidebar tab surfaces them via openregister-file-references. The status field drives a fail-closed lifecycle (draft → parsing → staged → mapping → validated|validation_failed → dry_run_complete → posting → posted|posting_failed → reversed), so the lifecycle toolbar is preserved via lifecycleActions. Audit trail lives in the canonical sidebarProps audit tab.

CONFIG archetype (native CnDetailPage). An import mapping ties one source-system account code to a target GL account for a batch — a configuration row a bookkeeper confirms (rgs-auto/profile-default pre-confirmed, manual needs confirmation, unmapped blocks validation). It has no child records of its own and no independent lifecycle state machine (ImportMapping carries no x-openregister-lifecycle), so per the config archetype the page is fields + audit trail only — no relatedLists, no lifecycleActions, no files.
